purpose: Determines whether a value represents XRP, the XRP Ledger's native asset.
importantNotes: `Asset::native()` provides equivalent functionality for `Asset` objects. Prefer `isXRP()` when checking whether an asset represents XRP, as it makes the intent more explicit.

examples.title: Checking an Asset
examples.code:
Asset const asset{xrpIssue()};
bool native = isXRP(asset);
